# RBesT: R Bayesian evidence synthesis tools

Tool-set to support Bayesian evidence synthesis. This includes
meta-analysis, (robust) prior derivation from historical data, operating
characteristics and analysis (1 and 2 sample cases). Please refer to
[Weber et al. (2021)](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v100.i19) for details
on applying this package while [Neuenschwander et
al. (2010)](https://doi.org/10.1177/1740774509356002) and [Schmidli et
al. (2014)](https://doi.org/10.1111/biom.12242) explain details on the
methodology.

## Getting Started

To get a quick overview over the package functionality, please refer to
the introductory
[vignettes](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/articles/index.html). We
recommend starting with the [Getting started with `RBesT`
(binary)](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/articles/introduction.html)
vignette as a first read.

# Package index

## Package overview

- [`RBesT`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/RBesT-package.md)
  [`RBesT-package`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/RBesT-package.md)
  : R Bayesian Evidence Synthesis Tools

## Prior derivation (Meta-Analytic-Predictive analysis)

Combine historical data into a Meta-Analytic-Predictive (MAP) prior and
inspect the model fit.

- [`gMAP()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/gMAP.md)
  [`print(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/gMAP.md)
  [`fitted(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/gMAP.md)
  [`coef(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/gMAP.md)
  [`as.matrix(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/gMAP.md)
  [`summary(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/gMAP.md)
  : Meta-Analytic-Predictive Analysis for Generalized Linear Models

- [`predict(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/predict.gMAP.md)
  [`print(`*`<gMAPpred>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/predict.gMAP.md)
  [`summary(`*`<gMAPpred>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/predict.gMAP.md)
  [`as.matrix(`*`<gMAPpred>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/predict.gMAP.md)
  : Predictions from gMAP analyses

- [`plot(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/plot.gMAP.md)
  : Diagnostic plots for gMAP analyses

- [`forest_plot()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/forest_plot.md)
  : Forest Plot

- [`as_draws(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/draws-RBesT.md)
  [`as_draws_matrix(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/draws-RBesT.md)
  [`as_draws_array(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/draws-RBesT.md)
  [`as_draws_df(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/draws-RBesT.md)
  [`as_draws_list(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/draws-RBesT.md)
  [`as_draws_rvars(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/draws-RBesT.md)
  :

  Transform `gMAP` to `draws` objects

- [`nsamples(`*`<gMAP>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/nsamples.gMAP.md)
  : Return the number of posterior samples

## Prior approximation

Approximate MCMC samples (or any sample) by a parametric mixture of
conjugate distributions.

- [`mixfit()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixfit.md) :
  Fit of Mixture Densities to Samples
- [`automixfit()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/automixfit.md)
  : Automatic Fitting of Mixtures of Conjugate Distributions to a Sample
- [`plot(`*`<EM>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/plot.EM.md)
  : Diagnostic plots for EM fits

## Effective sample size

Quantify the informativeness of a (mixture) prior.

- [`ess()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/ess.md) :
  Effective Sample Size for a Conjugate Prior

## Prior robustification

Make a prior robust against prior-data conflict.

- [`robustify()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/robustify.md)
  : Robustify Mixture Priors

## Design evaluation

Define decision rules and evaluate operating characteristics and the
probability of success for 1- and 2-sample designs.

- [`decision1S()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision1S.md)
  [`has_lower()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision1S.md)
  [`has_upper()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision1S.md)
  [`lower()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision1S.md)
  [`upper()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision1S.md)
  [`oc1Sdecision()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision1S.md)
  : Decision Function for 1 Sample Designs
- [`decision2S()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision2S.md)
  [`oc2Sdecision()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision2S.md)
  : Decision Function for 2 Sample Designs
- [`decision1S_boundary()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision1S_boundary.md)
  : Decision Boundary for 1 Sample Designs
- [`decision2S_boundary()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/decision2S_boundary.md)
  : Decision Boundary for 2 Sample Designs
- [`oc1S()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/oc1S.md) :
  Operating Characteristics for 1 Sample Design
- [`oc2S()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/oc2S.md) :
  Operating Characteristics for 2 Sample Design
- [`pos1S()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/pos1S.md) :
  Probability of Success for a 1 Sample Design
- [`pos2S()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/pos2S.md) :
  Probability of Success for 2 Sample Design

## Trial analysis

Conjugate posterior updating and predictive distributions used to
analyse the actual trial outcome.

- [`postmix()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/postmix.md)
  : Conjugate Posterior Analysis
- [`preddist()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/preddist.md)
  : Predictive Distributions for Mixture Distributions

## Mixture distributions

Construct, combine and evaluate mixture distributions.

- [`mixbeta()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixbeta.md)
  [`ms2beta()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixbeta.md)
  [`mn2beta()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixbeta.md)
  [`print(`*`<betaMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixbeta.md)
  [`print(`*`<betaBinomialMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixbeta.md)
  [`summary(`*`<betaMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixbeta.md)
  [`summary(`*`<betaBinomialMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixbeta.md)
  : Beta Mixture Density
- [`mixgamma()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixgamma.md)
  [`ms2gamma()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixgamma.md)
  [`mn2gamma()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixgamma.md)
  [`print(`*`<gammaMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixgamma.md)
  [`print(`*`<gammaPoissonMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixgamma.md)
  [`print(`*`<gammaExpMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixgamma.md)
  [`summary(`*`<gammaMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixgamma.md)
  [`summary(`*`<gammaPoissonMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixgamma.md)
  : The Gamma Mixture Distribution
- [`mixnorm()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixnorm.md)
  [`mn2norm()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixnorm.md)
  [`print(`*`<normMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixnorm.md)
  [`summary(`*`<normMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixnorm.md)
  [`sigma(`*`<normMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixnorm.md)
  [`` `sigma<-`() ``](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixnorm.md)
  : Normal Mixture Density
- [`mixmvnorm()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixmvnorm.md)
  [`msr2mvnorm()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixmvnorm.md)
  [`print(`*`<mvnormMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixmvnorm.md)
  [`summary(`*`<mvnormMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixmvnorm.md)
  [`sigma(`*`<mvnormMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixmvnorm.md)
  : Multivariate Normal Mixture Density
- [`mixcombine()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixcombine.md)
  : Combine Mixture Distributions
- [`dmix()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mix.md)
  [`pmix()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mix.md)
  [`qmix()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mix.md)
  [`rmix()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mix.md)
  [`` `[[`( ``*`<mix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mix.md)
  : Mixture Distributions
- [`dmixdiff()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixdiff.md)
  [`pmixdiff()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixdiff.md)
  [`qmixdiff()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixdiff.md)
  [`rmixdiff()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixdiff.md)
  : Difference of mixture distributions
- [`plot(`*`<mix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixplot.md)
  [`plot(`*`<mvnormMix>`*`)`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixplot.md)
  : Plot mixture distributions
- [`likelihood()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/likelihood.md)
  [`` `likelihood<-`() ``](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/likelihood.md)
  : Read and Set Likelihood to the Corresponding Conjugate Prior

## Interoperability and utilities

Read/write mixtures, use them in brms, and helper functions.

- [`mixstanvar()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixstanvar.md)
  :

  Mixture distributions as `brms` priors

- [`write_mix_json()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixjson.md)
  [`read_mix_json()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/mixjson.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Write and Read a Mixture Object with JSON

- [`logit()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/lodds.md)
  [`inv_logit()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/lodds.md)
  : Logit (log-odds) and inverse-logit function.

- [`BinaryExactCI()`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/BinaryExactCI.md)
  : Exact Confidence interval for Binary Proportion

## Datasets

- [`AS`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/AS.md) : Ankylosing
  Spondylitis.
- [`asthma`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/asthma.md) :
  Asthma exacerbation recurrent event data.
- [`colitis`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/colitis.md) :
  Ulcerative Colitis.
- [`crohn`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/crohn.md) :
  Crohn's disease.
- [`transplant`](https://opensource.nibr.com/RBesT/reference/transplant.md)
  : Transplant.
